summary: Le Du is a modern Thai fine-dining restaurant in Silom, centered on seasonal Thai produce and a choice of four- or six-course tasting menus. It remains listed as a one-MICHELIN-Star restaurant in the 2026 Thailand selection.
whyGo: A polished way to explore Thai ingredients and flavors through a changing tasting menu.
Convenient Silom location close to Chong Nonsi BTS.
bestFor: A special-occasion dinner, food-focused travelers and diners comfortable with tasting menus.
Groups of up to five choosing either menu length together.
skipIf: You want an inexpensive, casual or à-la-carte meal, or need a menu guaranteed to accommodate a particular restriction.
You cannot commit to the restaurant’s cancellation terms or a long multi-course dinner.
duration: Allow about 2.5–3 hours as a planning estimate; the restaurant does not publish a fixed meal duration.
cost: The official booking page lists 4,500 THB++ and 5,500 THB++ for its two tasting options. With the stated 10% service charge and 7% VAT, budget approximately 5,265 or 6,435 THB per person before drinks; confirm which price corresponds to each course length when booking.
hours: The Tourism Authority of Thailand lists 18:00–22:00 and Sunday closure. Reconfirm December 2026 service hours directly, since hours may change.
bestTime: Choose an available evening reservation; book early for December dates. No particular December seasonal menu has been announced in the sources checked.
gettingThere: Address: 399/3 Silom Soi 7, Bang Rak. The Tourism Authority of Thailand describes it as about a three-minute walk from Chong Nonsi BTS Exit 4. Allow extra time for the lane and evening traffic if using a taxi or ride-hail.
booking: Reserve through the restaurant’s official reservation page. Everyone in a party must choose the same four- or six-course menu; groups above five are required to take six courses. Submit dietary restrictions at least 72 hours ahead. Changes or cancellations inside 72 hours may incur a 5,000 THB per-person charge; read the current terms before confirming.
accessibility: Step-free access, accessible toilets, seating adaptations and other mobility provisions are not specified in the sources checked. Contact the restaurant before booking if access requirements matter.
practicalTips: State allergies and dietary restrictions when reserving, at least 72 hours before dining; ask the restaurant whether it can safely accommodate them.
Confirm the menu price, drink pairing prices, opening hours and table availability for your exact date.
The restaurant welcomes children over five but does not provide children’s facilities; children over ten receive the adult menu.
decemberNotes: December is a busy travel and dining period. Reserve as soon as dates are firm and verify holiday-week and year-end opening days with the restaurant; no December 2026 special schedule was published in the sources checked. The menu is seasonal, so expect dishes to vary rather than rely on older menu or photo examples.
uncertainties: The official booking page shows two prices but does not clearly pair each amount with its course length in the page text; verify the pairing at reservation.
Holiday hours, December 2026 menu, availability and any special event service are not yet confirmed.
Accessibility features and the estimated meal duration are not published in the checked sources.
